items.name: UST 10-Year Note auction result (USD 42bn, 2026-11-10 13:00 ET)
items.source: TheStreet Pro stock-market-today 2026-11-10; hererockhill.com 2026-11-11; BigGo Finance 2026-11-10; rallies.ai 2026-11-10; helious.io 2026-11-10 18:04 UTC; kucoin relay 2026-11-10 19:03 (all secondary; TreasuryDirect not read)
items.note: High yield 5.020% (coupon 5%, first 5% 10-year coupon since 2006); when-issued 5.010% (TheStreet) -> tail 1.0bp, 'largest tail since February' (TheStreet, hererockhill ~1bp, kucoin 'largest tail since Feb' no bp). DISAGREEMENT: helious.io prints 'stopped through 0.6bp' and 'in line' - outlier, not used. Bid-to-cover 2.46 vs 2.77 prior (Oct reopening), lowest since May; 6-month avg 2.60 (TheStreet) / 10-auction avg 2.54 (BigGo). Indirects 61.2% vs 80.3% prior (lowest since Oct 2023; 19.1pt drop biggest since Jul 2016), directs 29.0% vs 17.1% (highest since Sep 2013), dealers 9.8% vs 2.5% (most since May). Total bids about USD 103.3bn; 95.17% of bids at the high yield filled; median 4.961%. Settles 2026-11-16. Prior auction high yield 5.300%. CappNotes: 'soft, dealers left holding 10%'. Tail below 2bp.

items.name: CoreWeave Q3 2026 results - OCCURRED 2026-11-10 after close (8-K filed)
items.note: Occurred. Release: revenue USD 3,661m (+168% y/y), net loss USD 709m, adj. operating income USD 379m (10%), backlog about USD 132.5bn at 9-30, Q3 capex USD 14.5bn (company definition). FY26 guidance raised: revenue USD 13.0-13.3bn, adj. op income USD 1.275-1.375bn, capex USD 37-39bn (from USD 35bn low end), exit run-rate USD 20-21bn; Q4 net interest expense USD 1.05-1.15bn. Q3 highlights (not new deals): about USD 4.2bn upsized convertible senior notes, USD 2.6bn 'DDTL 5.5' facility for shorter-duration contracts, inaugural ATM up to 35m Class A shares. Expects about USD 9bn customer prepayments/deposits in next three months. DigiTimes (11-11, paywalled): management will not tap unsecured debt through 2027 at current yields; profit guided only in 2028. Shares +~1.5% after hours (CappNotes).
